question: Find users who own at least one post tagged with '<r>' and have earned a 'Teacher' badge. For these users, compute the total number of comments on all their '<r>'-tagged posts and return their display name, total comment count, and the average view count of those posts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
    COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS total_comment_count,
    AVG(p."XCL_030") AS average_view_count
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN badges AS b
    ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN posts AS p
    ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
LEFT JOIN comments AS c
    ON p."XCL_026" = c."XCL_006"
WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher'
  AND p."XCL_036" = '<r>'
GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"
